catalog.returns: Fresh flowers are non-returnable. If damaged on delivery, a replacement is free within 2 hours.

about.description: Petal Atelier is an independent Istanbul florist represented in this demo. Its agent may answer questions and prepare quotes from the published catalog and policies.
about.price_policy: Published prices apply equally to every customer. No bargaining or unlisted discounts.
about.demo_notice: Products, inventory, reviews and delivery promises are seeded demonstration data. Completing checkout records a simulated order; no payment is taken.

opening_hours.note: Opening hours describe shop availability. Delivery eligibility follows the published district-specific delivery data and the fixed demo clock.

occasions.suggestion: Ask about favorite flower, color, budget, district and card message.
Small rose or tulip bouquets are available; exact price depends on SKU and delivery district.
Red roses are available in multiple sizes. Confirm stock, budget and delivery before recommending.
White flowers and a separately priced vase are available. Include the vase in the quote if requested.
Ask the recipient color preference before choosing between pink, white and red.

wrapping.included: Standard natural paper wrapping is included in each listed product price.
wrapping.color_preferences: Ask the recipient flower-color preference; wrapping does not change the listed flower color.
wrapping.custom: Special packaging is an inquiry only. It has no published price and cannot be promised or added to a machine quote.

card_message.policy: A card message is optional and must not exceed 120 characters. Preserve the customer wording. Ask for a shorter message when over the limit; do not silently truncate.

published_addons.label: Card message
published_addons.description: One optional card message, limited to 120 characters.

published_addons.label: Glass vase
published_addons.description: One glass vase, charged in addition to bouquet and delivery.

care.general: The included care card recommends a clean vase, fresh water and keeping the bouquet away from direct heat. Follow the care card supplied with the flowers.
care.promise: No exact vase-life duration is promised in this catalog.

replacements.policy: Fresh flowers are non-returnable. If damaged on delivery, a replacement is free within 2 hours.
replacements.process: Report delivery damage within the stated 2-hour replacement window. The agent can explain this policy; this prototype cannot open or complete a replacement claim.

custom_and_events.inquiry: Custom arrangements and event flowers are consultation inquiries, not immediately orderable catalog items.
custom_and_events.policy: The agent may collect the brief and explain current catalog options. Do not invent a custom price, reserve inventory, promise a special lead time, or claim that a consultation has been booked.

gift_privacy.card: A card message is printed as supplied. If the sender omits their name, do not invent a signature.
gift_privacy.recipient: Recipient contact information belongs in human checkout. Do not ask for full contact details in the public URL question.
gift_privacy.pricing: The agent may explain current prices to the sender. This demo does not implement gift receipts or recipient notification.
gift_privacy.substitution: No automatic flower or color substitutions. Explain the difference and obtain the customer choice before creating a revised quote.

delivery.policy: Use the district fee and exact published same-day/next-day availability. No same-day promise outside a supported district. A requested deadline earlier than the published delivery window is not eligible.
delivery.schedule: A next-day delivery window begins at next_day_from; this is not an exact appointment. No exact delivery minute or special rush service is promised.

faq.question: Can you lower the price?
faq.answer: No. Published prices are the same for every customer. Ask about a smaller bouquet or a lower-priced eligible SKU instead.

faq.question: Can you replace an out-of-stock bouquet?
faq.answer: Show available substitutes, disclose different flower, color or stem count, and ask the customer to choose. Preserve any hard requirements.

faq.question: Is the vase included?
faq.answer: No. Standard wrapping is included; the optional glass vase costs 250 TRY in addition to bouquet and district delivery.

faq.question: Can I send a long message?
faq.answer: The free card supports up to 120 characters. Ask for a shorter message if it is longer.

faq.question: Can you deliver earlier than the listed window?
faq.answer: Only the published district delivery promises can be quoted. There is no separately priced rush delivery service.

faq.question: Can you arrange flowers for an event?
faq.answer: The agent can discuss the event brief and current catalog, but this prototype cannot book a custom consultation, promise an event delivery, or quote an unlisted arrangement.
